Name: Multi-Crop Garden Pots
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]MULTI-CROP GARDEN POTS
by KhaStark

Grow several copies of one crop in a single Garden Pot.

Multi-Crop Garden Pots adds five material-tier pots with increasing capacities, batch harvesting, persistent fertilizer, optional progression rules, optional Automate support, and Android-friendly behavior.

CAPACITIES
- Copper Garden Pot: 5 crops
- Iron Garden Pot: 15 crops
- Gold Garden Pot: 25 crops
- Iridium Garden Pot: 50 crops
- Prismatic Garden Pot: 100 crops

HOW IT WORKS
Each pot grows multiple copies of ONE crop type at a time. Crops inside the same pot are kept synchronized and are harvested together.

When more seeds are added to a partially filled pot, the whole batch restarts from day 1 so every crop in that pot stays synchronized.

Water normally with a watering can or sprinkler.

Fertilizer stays in the pot until the pot itself is removed. Tree fertilizers are rejected.

Giant crops are disabled inside Multi-Crop Garden Pots.


The mod can be configured to use either:

Crafting
Recipes unlock through Farming progression.

Purchase
All five pots are sold at Robin's.

You can also require the vanilla Garden Pot recipe to be learned before the custom pots become available.

SEASON OPTION
By default, crops in these pots can be protected from dying when the season changes.

This can be changed in the mod settings for players who prefer normal seasonal crop death.

If Automate is installed, connected storage can automatically plant/top up Multi-Crop Garden Pots.

Automate:
- uses the first valid seed type it finds;
- fills as much of the pot as possible with that same seed;
- never mixes crop types inside one pot;
- works with the different pot capacities;

Included:
- i18n/default.json
- TRANSLATING.txt

Translators only need to create a locale JSON file; the DLL does not need to be rebuilt.

OPTIONAL MODS
- Automate — automatic planting/top-up support.
- Generic Mod Config Menu — edit settings in-game.

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Extract the MultiCropGardenPots folder into your Mods folder.
3. Start the game through SMAPI.

UPDATING
Replace the old MultiCropGardenPots folder with the new version.

Do not install multiple versions of the mod at the same time.

AUTHOR
KhaStark[/font]
